fields.name: Start date - Check
fields.description: True if Start date = Start date - Rollback

fields.name: HS Deal ID
fields.description: HubSpot Deal ID - upsert key for sync script

fields.name: HS Contact ID
fields.description: HubSpot Contact ID - upsert key for sync script

fields.name: SKU - Normalised
fields.description: Returns the first 8 characters from the SKU field.

fields.name: Subscription - Duration - Normalised

tables.name: Documentation - Base - Structure
tables.description: Live registry of all cross-base sync relationships. Source of truth for the system graph. Last rebuilt 2026-03-25.

tables.name: Documentation - Automations
tables.description: Track automations for documentation processes, ensuring workflow clarity and automation insights.

tables.name: Documentation - Workflows
tables.description: Registry of documented operational workflows across the Giant Pumpkin Airtable system. Each record describes one end-to-end business process, with a full markdown description, scope mapping, and links to related automations and tables.

fields.name: Workflow - Name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the workflow (e.g., Quote-to-Operations: HubSpot to Jobs).

fields.name: Workflow - Slug
fields.description: Machine-readable identifier used for skill routing and query matching (e.g., quote-to-operations-hubspot). Lowercase, hyphenated.

fields.name: Scope - Bases
fields.description: Which bases are involved in this workflow.

fields.name: Scope - Tables
fields.description: List of tables touched by this workflow, formatted as Base > Table per line.

fields.name: Description - MD
fields.description: Full workflow documentation in markdown. Contains phases, data flow, tables involved, validation rules, and exception paths.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the workflow documentation.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Documentation priority. High = core revenue/operations, Medium = operational support, Low = reporting/analytics.

fields.name: Owner
fields.description: Person responsible for maintaining this workflow documentation.

fields.name: External Systems
fields.description: Non-Airtable systems involved in this workflow.

fields.name: Interfaces
fields.description: Named Airtable Interface views used in this workflow, with their purpose.

fields.name: Exception Paths
fields.description: Documented failure modes and what happens when each step in the workflow fails.

fields.name: Gaps - Known
fields.description: Known gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities identified during documentation.

fields.name: Version
fields.description: Version number of this workflow document. Increment on material changes.

fields.name: Last Reviewed
fields.description: Date this workflow documentation was last reviewed for accuracy.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Freeform notes, change log, or context about this workflow.

fields.name: Related Automations
fields.description: Link to Documentation - Automations records that are part of this workflow.

tables.name: Documentation - Integrations
tables.description: Registry of active integrations to external systems. Tracks metadata, architecture, data flow, and operational health for LLM-queryable system documentation.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: High-level narrative description of the integration. For complex integrations, structured markdown details go in Description - MD.

fields.name: Description - MD
fields.description: Structured markdown documentation for complex integration details: templates, sub-flows, configuration, artifact locations, and operational specifics that don't fit into flat fields.

fields.name: Xero Invoice ID
fields.description: Xero InvoiceID - upsert key for sync script

fields.name: Reference
fields.description: Xero Reference (free text; may contain quote number)

fields.name: Xero Status
fields.description: Xero Status (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED, PAID, VOIDED, DELETED)
